outcome: health indicators (self-rated health, changes in health)
postpartum health concerns (acute and ongoing conditions, undiagnosed concerns, pregnancy and reproductive health, mental health, weight/lifestyle concerns)
cohort: Postpartum Texans (n=1,489) with pregnancies covered by Medicaid/CHIP, recruited shortly after childbirth from eight hospitals in six cities.
finding: A majority of postpartum women with public insurance experienced insurance churn, leading to uninsurance and preventing many from receiving necessary health care.
